dataset: 12 previously used discovery weeks + separate May auxiliary; NO OOS
entry: On completed M15 candle t, close < minimum low of preceding 12 completed bars minus 0.10 ATR14; bearish real body >=0.35 ATR14, candle total range <=2.5 ATR14; 8-bar signal cooldown per symbol. Strict variant additionally requires EMA20<EMA60, EMA60 decreasing vs 8 bars earlier, and close<EMA20. Entry next M15 open (proxy, not proven maker fill). NEW PREDECLARED THIRD CANDIDATE: after a completed qualifying trend-filtered break at t, within next four completed M15 bars, require a candle high >= former 12-bar support - 0.15 ATR14 as measured at break t, and candle close < former support, bearish real body >= 0.15 ATR14 at break t; enter NEXT candle open after retest-close. No future bar is used at signal time. Do not apply retest variant to May differently from discovery.
exit: Short stop=max(signal candle high, next open+1.25 ATR14); TP=entry-1.8*(stop-entry); stop-first intrabar; stop gaps filled at worse open; time stop after 12 bars at close. Do not enter without complete 12-bar future horizon.
money: Initial equity 300 USDT, isolated 10x leverage proxy, notional <=500 USDT, stop-risk <=5 USDT per trade, 2 concurrent positions, max 1 per symbol, do not reuse collateral from open trades, no new positions when realized cash <=20 USDT. Primary net 20 bps per trade; stress 16, 25, 40 bps fixed-ledger; equity carry across 12 discovery weeks, May auxiliary separately reset. Rotating symbol priority by completed M15 timestamp only.
falsification: Compare trend-filtered structural shorts vs same breakdown without trend; report early and late six discovery weeks, per-week and per-symbol trades, net PnL, DD, missed margin/concurrency, equity depletion; no promise of liquidity data, maker fills or exchange liquidation realism. Compare third retest-after-break variant against both unchanged V1 controls and a no-trade baseline using the same 84 used discovery days and separate May AUX. All 3 versions fixed before NEW retest PnL; no OOS or maker fills. Never select a candidate solely by positive six-symbol subselection.
retest_method: TREND_RETEST_SHORT_V1 uses EMA20<EMA60, falling EMA60, bearish close below EMA20 at original break; retest rejection can appear 1 to 4 fully closed bars later. Break candle and retest candle each knowable at their respective close. Retest event ATR for stop sizing recomputed on retest completed candle; retest touch/rejection threshold uses original break-time ATR. Initial risk and money/fill model identical to frozen V1; no profit-lock or after-entry bar knowledge in entry.
previous_results: Preexisting original 2 variants REJECTED with aggregate FULL13 (2026-10-21). Their history is immutable in v1 manifest and the original GitHub run; this V2 is only a preregistered NEW third candidate plus unchanged baselines.
